title: Easy long run, back-to-back day 2
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: ~2h total, deliberately easy pace even if HR drifts on tired legs, this is about time on feet the day after a long mountain effort, not intensity.
GYM: none.
FUEL: 2 flasks Tailwind, same mix as Saturday.
STOP RULE: cut to 90min flat if the legs are trashed or any knee signal shows up.
WHY: day 2 of the back-to-back, the tired-leg-running adaptation that late-race VWT terrain demands.
